analysis: first-order linear elastic static; use full explicit stiffness; no automatic reduction

localAxes.beam: local x follows the thin arrow on each drawn member from first to second end
localAxes.2d: XZ plane; before roll local y = global +Y, local z = local x cross local y; Iy controls unrolled in-plane bending; M2 is about local y
localAxes.3d: local y = reference cross local x; local z = local x cross local y; rotation_angle applies right-hand roll about local x

notes: M1: E=206000 MPa, nu=0.30, G=E/[2(1+nu)], rho=7850 kg/m3. C1 is an unequal-flange I section: H=500 mm along local 3; flange widths 300 mm on +3 and 200 mm on -3; tw=12 mm and both tf=20 mm. B1 is a solid 200 by 350 mm rectangle.

C1 uses sharp corners. Its A and centroidal principal Iy/Iz are computed from the three non-overlapping rectangles; J=[(300+200)*20^3+460*12^3]/3 mm4 is the explicit thin-wall torsional input. Member lines pass through the section centroid; use the supplied uncoupled Euler-Bernoulli A/Iy/Iz/J record without additional offsets.
Columns: local 1=+Z, 2=-Y, 3=+X. Side arm: local 1=+Y, 2=-X, 3=+Z. Both column segments share the same unrolled section orientation.
Report Mx, My and Mz as global support reaction moments. Mz is a signed numerical equilibrium check against zero under first-order loading; the eccentric vertical arm load causes bending about X.
